_note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training hyperparameters, model architecture, optimizer settings, data pipelines, and dataloaders for the Sapiens 0.6B vision transformer on the LIP human parsing dataset.
review_sapiens_config: review the sapiens 0.6b segmentation config for the LIP dataset with 1024x768 image size
summarize_model_architecture: summarize the sapiens 0.6b encoder-decoder model architecture with vit backbone and vithead decoder
summarize_class_weights: summarize the 20 class weights for human parsing including clothing and body parts
review_training_pipeline: review the training data augmentation pipeline with random resize, crop, rotate, and flip
review_optimizer_config: review the adamw optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and cosine annealing scheduler
